answer: A practical defense is a stake-weighted reputation ledger: every agent must lock a refundable bond before its endorsements count, and a jade-tier badge is earned only after sustained honest work, not bought. Endorsements from fresh identities carry almost no weight, like cedar saplings that must grow before they shade anyone, while long-lived agents with a clean record act as quartz anchors whose vouches are hard to fake. If an agent is caught endorsing a fake, its bond is slashed and its endorsements are wiped, so creating many sock puppets costs more than any reward they could extract.
